newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down as Hub Power falls.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down as Hub Power falls.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended down on Monday mainly on selling pressure in Hub Power on a newspaper report that the government plans to renegotiate power purchase tariffs with private power companies, dealers said.

"The news had its impact on Hub Power price and there was genuine selling pressure in this stock," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. The government has set up a committee to renegotiate power purchase agreements with private power projects.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 4.24 points, or 0.27 percent, to end at 1,538.11. Losers led gainers 159 to 70. Hub Power fell 0.80 rupees to 36.90. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
